spec_reference: PLAN-v1.00.29-PROOF-GRAPH-REDUCTION.md §1.1/§6 W0/§4.7 (full-regression decomposed without inventing a completion time)

incident.completion_time_rationale: Run conclusion is 'cancelled'; the test-platform lane never reached a terminal suite result. Per spec §1.1 no completion time is invented; wall time is bounded by run created_at..last_updated_at only.

provenance.source: GitHub Actions API page-1 evidence retained at commit-time
provenance.extraction: job.started_at/completed_at and job.steps[] timestamps from retained API payloads; durations integer seconds

job_matrix.note: gated off; API completed_at precedes started_at for skipped jobs

step_breakdown_retained.note: cancelled mid-suite at 2026-09-10T08:58:28Z — suite never completed

wall_clock_dominator.finding: Environment preparation, not test execution. setup-racket on test-platform (macos-14) consumed 5199s (86m39s) = 90.2% of the 96m05s run wall and 95.8% of the critical-path job.
wall_clock_dominator.mechanism_classification: prepared-env restore did not take effect on this scheduled run path: the CI 'Clear stale bytecode' step is conditioned on prepared-env-result != 'success', and the follow-on catalog/dependency installation ran unbounded on the macOS runner instead of restoring a prepared environment archive.
wall_clock_dominator.evidence: step timestamps in retained jobs-34450089330.json; compare workflows-suite setup-racket 245s (07:28:08Z->07:32:13Z) and summarize setup-racket 244s on ubuntu-latest for the same commit window.

proof_work_mass.finding: Actual proof work that completed before cancellation is small. All 6 Linux shards finished in 466..686s (max 11m26s incl. setup); workflows-suite finished in 363s; the platform-cross suite had executed only 91s of its runtime when the run was cancelled.
proof_work_mass.note: Per-shard step-level breakdown exists in the retained payload but only the critical-path job is decomposed step-wise here; shard job-level durations are retained verbatim.

wait_mass_vs_work_mass.finding: The incident is dominated by wait mass (environment preparation) rather than work mass (proof execution): 5199s setup vs 91s of platform suite execution observed before cancellation.

cancellation.origin: unknown (cancel actor is not present in the retained API evidence)
hypotheses_non_asserted: concurrency-group preemption by a newer scheduled run
downstream_effects: summarize job failed at step 'Aggregate all required lane evidence' because test-platform lane evidence was incomplete (dependency on a cancelled lane), after spending 244s of its own 253s wall on setup-racket
report job emitted the definitive run status (3s, success)

completion_time.policy: Not invented. The platform lane was cancelled mid-suite; extrapolating shard rates to macos-14 (whose setup cost alone was 57x the longest Linux shard) would fabricate a number the evidence cannot support.

w1_hooks: Metric contract (PERFORMANCE-CONTRACT-v1.00.29.md) tracks setup_ratio per surface so prepared-env restore failures on scheduled paths surface before the 90-minute scale.
Critical-path latency metric for full-regression must separate wait mass (env prep) from work mass (suite runtime) exactly as decomposed here.
Cancel-origin telemetry is currently absent from the proof graph (unknown class); W1+ may add a cancel-actor observation surface without changing behavior.
